description: This Java class `ModuleFilterDefinition` defines a data structure for capturing details about filters included in an OpenMRS module, including loading such definitions from XML configuration elements. It handles properties like filter name, class, initialization parameters, and provides static methods to parse filter configurations from a module XML document.

classes.name: ModuleFilterDefinition
classes.description: Represents the configuration of a web filter within a module, including its name, class, and initialization parameters.

methods.name: retrieveFilterDefinitions
methods.description: Static method that parses the module's XML configuration to retrieve a list of filter definitions.

methods.name: addInitParameter
methods.description: Adds a parameter for initializing the filter.
